items.stem: An app is being blocked from running on Windows 11 SE. Which logs should you check for blocked executables?

options.text: AppLocker and CodeIntegrity logs in Event Viewer
options.rationale: Correct: these logs show whether executables related to the app are blocked.
DNS logs are unrelated to blocked executables.
IIS logs track web requests, not app blocking.
Firewall rules control network traffic, not executable blocking.
